en: Fixed Claude reporting a message to another session as delivered when that session held it: the notice now says it wasn't delivered and names the session, and in SDK sessions Claude can now learn of it mid-turn
zh: 修复了 Claude 将发给另一个 session 的消息误报为已送达的问题：当该 session 暂存了该消息时，现在会提示未送达并指明该 session；在 SDK session 中，Claude 现在可以在回合中途获知此情况
